arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos TGT Request from Non-DC Host
logsource:
  product: windows
  event_id: 4768
condition:
  - source_ip|cidr != '10.0.8.0/24'
  - destination_ip: '10.0.8.200'
  - status: 'failure'
  - event_count >= 10 within 10m
level: high
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate authentication testing (requires change control)
description: Detects potential credential stuffing against domain controller from non-domain controller subnets.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with specific URI pattern and User-Agent"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "high"
    strings:
        $uri1 = "/admin/get.php" wide ascii
        $uri2 = "/news.php" wide ascii
        $ua = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Cobalt Strike Beacon Traffic
logsource:
  product: firewall
  service: netflow
detection:
  c2_pattern:
    dst_ip: 198.51.100.77
    protocol: tcp
    dst_port: 443
    frequency: > 5/min
  edr_heartbeat_exception:
    src_user: 'edr-agent-service'
    process: 'edr-heartbeat.exe'
  condition: c2_pattern and not edr_heartbeat_exception
level: critical
